pairing_rule: Use matched baseline/candidate assigned workloads with equal verification/risk and precommitted eligible-wake, exposure/censoring and admission/defer/timeout policies. Randomize AB/BA or crossover from the same sealed starting snapshot, reset candidate-sensitive runtime state between arms, preserve external monotonic audit state, report order interaction and intention-to-treat coverage.

denominator_integrity.rule: Speed cannot be established if the candidate changes wake eligibility, exposure horizon, censoring, treatment order, warm-state, workload admission, defer/reject/timeout behavior, or the set of tasks included in completed-only metrics.
denominator_integrity.reject: Candidate-dependent wake coalescing, shorter observation windows, excluded recovery/verifier-wait/failure time, fixed treatment order, selective deferral/rejection/timeout of hard assigned work, or lower workload coverage cannot support a speedup claim.

selection_bias_control.rule: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis. Count every assigned unit and report completion, verified closure, defer, reject, timeout and coverage rates plus assignment-to-closure latency with common right-censoring/bounded failure semantics.
selection_bias_control.required_adversarial: Force the candidate to defer the hardest workload stratum; any completed-only apparent speedup must be rejected if ITT/coverage-aware analysis does not confirm it.
